WHO Investigates Russian Plague Researcher's Pneumonia Death

The World Health Organization (WHO) is investigating the cause of pneumonia that led to the death of a plague researcher in Russia. A week after the incident, Russian authorities have not yet disclosed the specific pathogen responsible for the illness. The WHO has issued an update on its ongoing investigation into the death.
